label.en: Metastatic colorectal cancer — 5 mg/kg every 2 weeks (with IFL or second-line regimen)

text.fa: با FOLFOX4: ۱۰ mg/kg هر ۲ هفته؛ یا ۷٫۵ mg/kg هر ۳ هفته در خط دوم. ۲۸ روز قبل و بعد از جراحی بزرگ نه.
text.en: With FOLFOX4: 10 mg/kg every 2 weeks; or 7.5 mg/kg every 3 weeks second-line. Not within 28 days before or after major surgery.

text.fa: فقط زیر نظر پزشک متخصص انکولوژی؛ پروتکل، فاصله دوره‌ها و تنظیم با تیم درمان.
text.en: Only under an oncologist; protocol, cycle interval and adjustment rest with the treating team.

text.en: Recurrent glioblastoma and renal cell carcinoma: 10 mg/kg every 2 weeks; cervical cancer: 15 mg/kg every 3 weeks.

text.fa: سوراخ‌شدگی گوارش و فیستول؛ اختلال ترمیم زخم؛ خونریزی؛ ترومبوآمبولی شریانی و وریدی؛ فشار خون؛ PRES؛ پروتئینوری؛ واکنش انفوزیون؛ نارسایی تخمدان؛ نارسایی قلب.
text.en: GI perforation and fistula; wound-healing complications; haemorrhage; arterial and venous thromboembolism; hypertension; PRES; proteinuria; infusion reactions; ovarian failure; heart failure.

pregnancy.quote: Risk Summary Based on findings from animal studies and its mechanism of action [see Clinical Pharmacology (12.1) ], Avastin may cause fetal harm in pregnant women.

lactation.quote: Because of the potential for serious adverse reactions in breastfed infants, advise women not to breastfeed during treatment with Avastin and for 6 months after the last dose.
